description: This file defines a function `makeAnthropicMessagesRequest` that interacts with the Anthropic AI SDK to send message streams, handle streaming responses, and process various callbacks related to message content, usage, and timing data. It imports external SDKs and components, manages request headers, and handles streaming communication with the Anthropic API.

methods.name: makeAnthropicMessagesRequest
methods.description: An asynchronous function that sends a streaming message request to the Anthropic API, handles incoming streamed messages, processes content deltas, and invokes callbacks for UI updates, timing, and usage data.
